title: Brand settings
description: Show a different site name and logo for each visiting origin. Sites without a matching entry keep the default brand.
corsHint: Saved origins are also allowed to access backend resources and operations. Include the protocol and port when needed. Use a public logo URL; HTTPS sites require an HTTPS logo.
saveFailed: Unable to save brand settings. Please try again.
loadFailed: Unable to load brand settings. Please try again.
empty: No custom brands yet. All sites use the default name and logo.
name: Site name
invalidOrigin: Enter an HTTP(S) origin, including an optional port, without a path, query or fragment.
invalidName: Enter a site name containing 1–100 characters.
invalidLogo: Enter an absolute HTTP(S) logo URL without credentials.
duplicateOrigin: This origin already has a brand. Edit the existing entry instead.
secureLogo: Use an HTTPS logo URL for an HTTPS site.
